title: MCP VulnLab server manifest
description: The file at corpus/servers/<slug>/manifest.json. Tells the harness how to launch the server and what kind of challenge it is.

slug.description: Directory name. Unique across the corpus.

kind.description: 'control' servers are benign and exist to measure false positives. They must have zero exploits.

summary.description: One sentence: what this server does and why it is in the corpus.

entrypoint.description: Path relative to the challenge directory. Launched as `<python> <entrypoint>` with cwd set to the challenge directory.

args.description: Extra argv passed after the entrypoint.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process. Values here end up in the repo, so never put secrets in this file.

categories.description: Convenience mirror of the categories present in exploits.json. Must agree with it — validation cross-checks this.
